example.title: Gehry House: the architect's own 1978 remodel of a corner bungalow
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: Frank Gehry's own house, 1978: a pink-and-brown shingled 1920s gambrel bungalow wholly wrapped and rebuilt in corrugated galvanised steel, plywood, chain-link and raw timber, with a tilted glass cube bursting out of the kitchen corner, a chain-link screen on the roof and angled skylights; asphalt-floored kitchen at street level, big trees on the corner. Five photos. (The 1920s core is pre-1970; the building as seen is the 1978 rebuild.) Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
